scope: Independent deterministic source lifecycle probe after performance changes; callback counts, not browser CPU or heap measurements.
reviewDisposition: Publishing only changed scale/x/y/dragging avoids redundant reactive work without losing second-finger, final-lift, cancellation or capped-zoom dragging transitions.
Stable Svelte view proxy keeps pan-only x/y changes from invalidating scale-dependent sampling/checker calculations.
Primitive sampling target plus untracked equality guard skips mount and unchanged-target refinement timers while preserving cleanup for obsolete targets.
No recurring navigation polling, animation frame loop or idle timer was found in the source. Repeated lifecycle probes found no retained navigation listeners or hold timers.
limits: Fake event surfaces prove deterministic source lifecycle behavior; native browser capture and Svelte reactive scheduling require separate integration checks.
A mounted idle viewer still owns event listeners; unowned pointer moves perform a Map lookup. Static navigation JS/CSS bytes remain loaded after closing.

Existing GIF playback, tooltip feedback, comparison and automatic output-color inspection can perform work independently of navigation; these checks do not claim the whole viewer or application has zero idle CPU or memory.
No browser CPU speedup, battery improvement, process-memory bound or physical-device frame rate is inferred from callback reductions.
